title: Conformal invariance of critical bond percolation on the square lattice
current_status_reason: Dated sources say open; primary preprints claim proofs. Their correctness and an accepted resolution were not established in this bounded check.
intake_statement: Prove that critical bond percolation on Z^2 at p = 1/2 is conformally invariant in the scaling limit (Cardy's formula and convergence of interfaces to SLE(6)), as is known on the triangular lattice by Smirnov.

working_quantifiers.interfaces: Separate Dobrushin primal/dual exploration clause, convergence to chordal SLE(6) modulo increasing reparametrization.
